name: manual-capture-cell
description: Ephemeral cell for manual content capture and wireframe generation. Creates file-editor-v2 cells with captured content.

default_initial_data.placeholder: Enter content to capture or HTML to generate wireframe...

category.description: Cell category - 'ephemeral' marks this as ephemeral (not persisted)

placeholder.default: Enter content to capture or HTML to generate wireframe...

_discovery.describe: Manual data capture utility for entering structured data through forms. Provides customizable form fields with validation (text, numbers, dates, dropdowns, checkboxes). Supports schema-driven form generation from JSON schemas. Instant data validation and submission (~100ms). Useful for capturing user inputs, configuration data, and structured information that feeds into other cells. Includes data export capabilities (JSON, CSV).
